derived_from.note: Design credit for the scoring, selection and determinism blocks below is brandonmusic's. This file is our independent, dependency-free restatement of it plus the lane/floor block he does not carry. No source code of his is copied into this repository; see docs/PROTOCOL-ALIGNMENT.md section 'Licence'.

scoring.scored_position_policy: all next-token positions; row r predicts tokens[r+1]; never shift
scoring.batch: one window per forward, fresh state per window

calibration_overlap_scan.document_check: exclude a final window whose document_id appears in any non-final role
calibration_overlap_scan.ngram_digest: blake2b, digest_size=12, over int64 little-endian token bytes
calibration_overlap_scan.ngram_denominator: size of the deduplicated n-gram set of the final window
calibration_overlap_scan.ngram_scan_scope: all non-final panel windows (fit, conditional-fit, selection, confirmation)
calibration_overlap_scan.threshold_status: INHERITED FROM brandonmusic AND NOT YET JOINTLY AGREED. It is a bare literal with no published sensitivity analysis. See docs/PROTOCOL-ALIGNMENT.md for our sensitivity table.

scopes.clean17: the 17 windows surviving the scan; 34799 scored positions
scopes.rule: publish BOTH; never compare a clean-scope number against a panel-scope number

uncertainty.document_cluster: reported but not primary (the packed corpus has only 3-4 source documents)
uncertainty.bootstrap: window-level block bootstrap, B=5000, seed=20260829, percentile AND BCa
uncertainty.max_statistic_rule: report max only with its N; never compare max across different N
uncertainty.sigma_run: population sample stddev (ddof=1) of per-run means over the COMMON window set
uncertainty.total_se_rule: SE_total = hypot(SE_clustered, sigma_run); report both parts
uncertainty.sigma_run_gate_meaning: sigma_run / SE_clustered above this means the run-to-run term is not negligible and must be quoted in the headline
uncertainty.ranking_rule: rank two students by PAIRED per-token (or per-window) differences with a CI, plus McNemar on top-1; never by eyeballing overlapping marginal CIs

determinism.evidence: content hashes of the per-token KL array or the student logits; a receipt-file or container hash never counts

canary_r0.self_kld: teacher scored against itself must be EXACTLY 0.0 at every scored position, at session start AND session end
canary_r0.shift_explosion: re-scoring with the student rows shifted by one position must raise mean KLD to entropy scale; the gate is mean_kld_shifted >= shift_ratio_min * teacher_mean_entropy
canary_r0.on_failure: abort the session; never shift the alignment to make the canary pass

lane.note: This block is malaiwah's addition; brandonmusic's protocol has no equivalent and his own data demonstrates the need for it (0.0305 vs 0.0246 for one artifact).
lane.definition: same_stack = teacher reference logits and student logits produced by the same runtime and code path. cross_stack = they were not.
lane.floor_rule: every lane must publish its own measured BF16-vs-BF16 floor on the same panel and the same teacher receipt
lane.attributable_error: row mean minus the SAME-LANE floor; publishing a subtracted number without the raw row and the floor beside it is forbidden

reporting.protocol_stamp: every emitted receipt carries protocol_schema, protocol_file_sha256 and protocol_scoring_sha256

canonical_hash.file_hash_subject: the raw bytes of this file
canonical_hash.scoring_hash_subject: canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii, UTF-8) of the object {scoring, selection, uncertainty, determinism, canary_r0, lane, reporting}
canonical_hash.why_two: brandonmusic's rule hashes raw file bytes. His own campaign broke it: three different protocol_sha256 values appear across his published receipts because the file was hand-edited twice AFTER generation to add identity blocks that do not affect scoring. A scoring-subset hash is invariant to those edits, so a comparison across receipts stays valid when only identity metadata changed. We publish BOTH: the file hash for byte-level provenance, the scoring hash for comparability.
